notes:
Your CPU clock now follows a voltage limit you set. Pick the limit, and the console
runs the fastest clock it can actually hold under it, measured on your own chip
during normal play. The CPU clock tuner is gone; there is nothing to run.

New default limit: 1120 mV on V2 and OLED, 1225 mV on V1. This update applies it to
every console, so your top clock may change. Raise the limit on the Overclock tab if
you want more.

Also: GPU undervolt now moves in 5 mV steps and survives a restart, the tuning
progress screen shows a QR code you can scan to watch from your phone, and Cemu's
fast-forward and game options appear in the pause menu on the first launch.

Fixed: a CPU max clock that kept dropping on its own and never came back.
